A block marker on a continuation line of multiline alt text is escaped

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<img alt=\"Alpha\n-\nBeta\" src=\"image.png\">");
var_dump($result->content);
```
